note: Vocabulary, not presets. Every recipe is a tested starting move: change the numbers, the palette roles and the audio mapping for the briefing at hand, and never ship one unchanged. Build a layer with: python scripts/recipes.py layer <id> --set key=value

recipes.title: Superformula contours
recipes.principle: Gielis superformula r(t)=(|cos(mt/4)|^n2+|sin(mt/4)|^n3)^(-1/n1): one equation spans circles, stars, flowers, polygons, leaves
means: natural form made by one law
recipes.loop: closes: exponents move in whole sine cycles; m even 1 turn, m odd 2

audio.bass: exponent n1 and ring pressure (shape breathes)

recipes.wide: centred hero; on strips use one per height-sized module (place several layers) or raise rings

recipes.title: Clifford attractor cloud
recipes.principle: strange attractor of the map x'=sin(ay)+c cos(ax), y'=sin(bx)+d cos(by); parameters travel a circle once per loop
means: a system that never repeats yet stays itself
recipes.loop: closes: a,b,c,d on a circle, whole cycles

audio.bass: morph depth (the cloud swells and reshapes on the kick)

recipes.wide: `copies` repeats it across the width with phase offsets: the same law, a different state per module

recipes.title: Pendulum wave
recipes.principle: pendulum i oscillates base+floor(i*spread) whole cycles per loop: the row re-synchronises exactly at the seam and draws travelling waves, standing waves and moire between (side view)

audio.bass: amplitude (the row swells on the kick)

recipes.wide: native to wide canvases: the row spans the width; raise count with the width

recipes.title: Wave interference dot field
recipes.principle: superposition of circular waves from orbiting point sources: constructive interference swells the dots, destructive interference dims them
recipes.loop: closes: sources orbit whole turns, wave advances 2 cycles per loop
recipes.wide: excellent on LED walls: the grid is the pixel language; set cell to a multiple of the LED pixel pitch

recipes.title: Spirograph family with a tracing head
recipes.principle: hypotrochoid with R:r = p:q closes after q turns; a bright head traces each curve exactly once per loop and leaves a fading tail (stroke progress)
recipes.loop: closes: head = one revolution of the curve per loop, pen distance on a sine

audio.bass: pen distance (the figure opens on the kick)

recipes.wide: centred; repeat as several layers with different seeds for a strip

recipes.title: Kepler orbits
recipes.principle: bodies on ellipses with the orbital period following Kepler's third law (inner fast, outer slow), solved in closed form from the mean anomaly
means: a system governed by one law
recipes.loop: closes: whole orbits per loop, M = 2 pi n phase
recipes.wide: centred; on strips run two layers with different seeds, or set the centre by wall

recipes.title: Radial stagger grid
recipes.principle: each cell pulses once per bar with a delay proportional to its distance from a seeded origin: one ripple crosses the wall (stagger from a point, ease on the delay)
recipes.loop: closes: every cell is in the same small state at bar start and end
recipes.wide: the grid fills any aspect; set cell to a multiple of the LED pixel pitch
recipes.usage: The ripple covers the whole wall, so over a busy hero (Chladni, quasicrystal) it reads as grey noise. Give the layer opacity 0.4 to 0.6, a cell several times the hero's line spacing, or run it alone as a structure tier under a sparse hero. Test with the hero on and off.

recipes.title: Chladni figures
recipes.principle: nodal lines of a vibrating plate, f = cos(n pi x)cos(m pi y) - cos(m pi x)cos(n pi y); two mode pairs blended so the figure morphs
recipes.loop: closes: the mode blend is a whole sine cycle
recipes.wide: one plate per height-sized module, each with a different mode pair: natural for strips

recipes.title: Quasicrystal
recipes.principle: n plane waves at equal angles interfere into an aperiodic pattern with n-fold symmetry and no translational repeat
recipes.loop: closes: each wave advances 1 or 2 whole cycles
recipes.wide: covers any aspect without stretching; frequency is in height units

recipes.title: Domain colouring of a rational function
recipes.principle: the plane is the complex plane; iso-lines of argument and modulus of f(z) converge on zeros and poles that orbit with the loop
recipes.loop: closes: zero and pole coefficients orbit on circles (1 and 2 turns)
recipes.wide: no stretching; zoom p1 in height units

recipes.title: Julia set on an orbit
recipes.principle: z <- z^2 + c with c on a circle; a full revolution morphs the set and returns exactly; smooth escape time drives outward bands
recipes.loop: closes: c = r e^{i 2 pi phase}
recipes.cost: medium (56 iterations per pixel; use res 0.5-0.7 on big canvases)
recipes.wide: fills any aspect; zoom p1 in height units
